column7: ApproveMFAReset checked the approver's admin role and active state only before its transaction, so an approver demoted, suspended or deactivated between that check and the commit still completed the reset. The approval now row-locks requester, approver and target in ascending user-ID order inside the transaction and re-runs the approver checks there; the change is injected on the approval transaction's own handle right before the approver's lock and the approval must be refused with no decision, no credential change and no successful approval row (its DENIED row is MFA-RESET-TAILS-2-IN-TX-DENIAL-AUDITED).
